result.title: GTC SJ 2026: Physical AI for Healthcare Robotics - Simulation-First Design & Accelerated Development
result.description:
Discover how simulation-first design is radically changing how medical and healthcare robots are prototyped, tested, and built. As global healthcare systems navigate severe supply-and-demand crises, physical AI and robotics stand out as critical solutions to boost efficiency and clinical accuracy.

This session showcases how engineering teams leverage the NVIDIA Physical AI ecosystem - including world foundation models, physics-based simulations, high-fidelity digital twins, synthetic data generation, and real-time sensor-to-action deployment - to accelerate time-to-market while vastly lowering clinical risks long before technologies enter the operating room.

result.title: Firebird Launches CIS Region’s Largest AI Factory in Armenia
result.description:
NVIDIA pioneered accelerated computing to tackle problems beyond the reach of ordinary computers and is working with AI cloud partners to expand access to AI factories around the world.

Watch NVIDIA Founder and CEO Jensen Huang celebrate Firebird’s launch of the CIS region’s largest AI factory in Armenia, establishing a new AI computing hub powered by NVIDIA accelerated computing and Dell Technologies high-performance AI infrastructure. The project is intended to bring global demand for AI infrastructure, local development opportunities, and new economic growth to the region

➡️ Learn more: https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/firebird-ai-factory-armenia-blackwell-rubin-dsx
